name: CN_TP_SIM_PC_RESULTS_ALL
description: This table stores Calculation Simulations results aggregated at plan component level.

columns.name: SIM_PC_RESULT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the simulation's aggregated result by plan component.

columns.name: SIMULATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the simulation associated to the row.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: SRP_COMP_PLAN_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the association between the sales rep and the compensation plan related to the row.

columns.name: COMP_PLAN_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the compensation plan associated to the row.

columns.name: PLAN_COMPONENT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the plan component associated to the row.

columns.name: FORMULA_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the incentive formula associated to the row.

columns.name: PAY_PERIOD_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the payment period associated to the row.

columns.name: CURRENT_EARNINGS_SUM_CALC
columns.description: The sum of the earnings in calculation currency already earned by a participant before the calculation simulation.

columns.name: CURRENT_EARNINGS_SUM_HOME
columns.description: The sum of the earnings in home currency already earned by a participant before the calculation simulation.

columns.name: CURRENT_EARNINGS_SUM_FUNC
columns.description: The sum of the earnings in functional currency already earned by a participant before the calculation simulation.

columns.name: GAIN_SUM_CALC
columns.description: The sum of the gain in calculation currency calculated during the calculation simulation.

columns.name: GAIN_SUM_HOME
columns.description: The sum of the gain in home currency calculated during the calculation simulation.

columns.name: GAIN_SUM_FUNC
columns.description: The sum of the gain in functional currency calculated during the calculation simulation.

columns.name: CALC_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Calculation currency code.

columns.name: HOME_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Participant's home currency code.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
